note: 'verified' = read from the vendor's official docs on the date above; 'unverified' = not confirmed, treat as a best guess.

claude-code.instruction_file: CLAUDE.md (also reads AGENTS.md per memory docs)
claude-code.frontmatter: name defaults to folder; description recommended

opencode.instruction_file: AGENTS.md, else CLAUDE.md (first found wins); extra files via 'instructions' in opencode.json
opencode.frontmatter: name (must equal folder, <=64, lowercase-hyphen) + description (<=1024) required

kilo-code.project_skills_dir: .kilo/skills, .agents/skills (.claude/skills only with Claude Code compatibility enabled)
kilo-code.frontmatter: name + description required (name <=64, lowercase-hyphen; docs inconsistent on folder match, so keep them equal)

antigravity.instruction_file: unverified (AGENTS.md/GEMINI.md and rules are not named in the skills codelab)
antigravity.global_skills_dir: varies by product/version: ~/.gemini/config/skills, ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/skills, ~/.gemini/antigravity/skills, ~/.agents/skills (IDE picks up; CLI does not)
antigravity.frontmatter: description mandatory; name optional (defaults to folder)

status.skills_paths: verified for project scope; global varies
